Requests for a variance from the requirements of Section 27-1014(b)(4) shall be limited to
requests to remove a damaged or inoperable sprinkler system in connection with demolition or
gut rehabilitations. Such requests shall be filed with the Department as an Alteration Type II by
a licensed professional in accordance with the following procedure:
